cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A

confusable: Not demanding a flattering adjective: A pushes from scale-free thanks to what the effort concretely restored and enabled.
comparison: Physical stage repair credited publicly versus recovered records credited in a trip account.
